title: Introduce RAG Embedded Tool Factory quickstart and compact agent starter
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Adds a compact RAG quickstart demonstrating an 'embedded tool factory' pattern, includes TypeScript and Go starter agents, updated docs and telemetry probes. No breaking API changes.
body: Description: Add a compact, opinionated quickstart (quickstarts/rag-embedded-tool-factory) that demonstrates embedding small tool factories into RAG agents for browser and server runtimes; includes a minimal TypeScript agent, a Go headless starter, a lightweight browser shim for toolbinding, and docs snippets for structured-output linting. Motivation: Teams building RAG features often want a low-friction path to add tool-calling with strong type guarantees and minimal infra; this quickstart shows a repeatable pattern that is compatible with the Redwood API, local dev, and CI-based smoke tests. Checklist: - [x] TS starter agent + examples - [x] Go headless starter + README - [x] Browser shim (compact) for embedded tools - [x] Structured-output contract examples and lint snippets - [x] Telemetry probes and sample metrics - [x] Tests and CI job - [x] Docs site snippets and cross-links Implementation summary: commits: Commit 1: scaffold quickstart folder and README with motivation and architecture sketch; Commit 2: add typesafe tool-binding runtime (TS) and example tool adapters (http-adapter, file-store stub); Commit 3: add Go headless agent starter and example invocation harness; Commit 4: browser shim (wasm/iframe-lite) and example index.html; Commit 5: docs updates, telemetry probe presets and CI smoke job; Commit 6: address review comments and small test fixes. Files changed (high level): - quickstarts/rag-embedded-tool-factory/README.md (new example quickstart doc) - quickstarts/rag-embedded-tool-factory/ts-starter/* (agent + examples) - quickstarts/rag-embedded-tool-factory/go-starter/* (headless agent + harness) - quickstarts/rag-embedded-tool-factory/browser-shim/* (compact toolbinding shim) - docs/snippets/rag-tool-factory.md (docs site snippets + code samples) - ci/smoke-quickstarts.yml (new smoke job to run headless example) - telemetry/presets/rag-embedded-tool-factory.json (sample probe preset) - tests/quickstarts/rag-embedded-tool-factory-smoke.test.ts (CI smoke test) Review conversation: Liam: "Nice pattern; please split the TS runtime into runtime/core and example to make it importable by other quickstarts"; Author: "Done — moved core into ts-starter/runtime and added README on public APIs (see commit 4)"; Ruth: "Docs snippets are good but add an explicit example of structured-output linter failing case"; Author: "Added failing-case snippet plus expected lint output in docs (commit 5)"; Omar: "Can the browser shim avoid iframe in constrained CSP environments?"; Author: "Provided an alternate message-channel-based connector and documented tradeoffs in README (commit 6)"; CI: GitHub Actions - quickstarts/build (pass); node/test (pass); go/test (pass); lint (pass); smoke-quickstarts (pass on rerun after fixes). Observability/telemetry: added minimal telemetry presets to capture tool call latency, tool error counts, and end-to-end session durations; included sample Grafana dashboard JSON in telemetry/presets. Backwards compatibility and security: no changes to Redwood public API; tooling examples use the public SDKs and default auth flows; browser shim warns about exposing keys and recommends server-mediated tool proxies. How to run locally (short): 1) cd quickstarts/rag-embedded-tool-factory/ts-starter; 2) npm i && npm run dev -- reads README for ENV variables; 3) run the go harness at quickstarts/rag-embedded-tool-factory/go-starter/harness to exercise headless example. Merge notes: squash merge; included a short changelog in the README and docs site cross-links; CI green on final run. Related: ENG-5234 (pattern proposal), DOC-118 (docs task).
